title: feat(parnn): parallel-step reverse and face are undefined
science: Parallel-step dual (allowed step must be PARALLEL to the parent lock) on taxicab B_3(0): the process fills only the seed axis {(n,0,0):|n|<=3} with t=|n|; B and D never form, so reverse and face are UNDEFINED, not false. Establishes that the perpendicular constraint is exactly what makes the lock process fill space at all - the parallel dual collapses to one dimension. Runner verifies undefined-vs-false gating explicitly.
